questions.old_question: Does the documented gate cover every new physical launch route, including recovery of a retained start, or is the intended property limited to fresh starts?
questions.answer: Both stopped-unit start and restart call Lilly.Private.Readiness.ready?/1 before Driver.start/restart. The already-running branch only adopts.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Remove this open question and say the new physical start boundary includes stopped-unit restart/recovery.
